My dear [Pixie](/person/539)
Your questions are all so good, I don't know which to choose, but I think we had better have the citizen of Athens, and the history of the Glorias[^1]

your faithful
Mother Goose


[^1]: The members of the [Gosling Society](/topic/104) took it in turns to pose questions for each other to write on, and the essays were read by CMY.
